transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I know everyone keeps telling me I’m wrong, but I’m absolutely certain about what my husband is hiding from me, and nothing they say changes my mind. It is incredibly frustrating when the people closest to you refuse to see the truth.

Besides your concerns about your husband, have you been experiencing any other unusual changes, such as hearing voices that others cannot hear or feeling like your thoughts are being controlled by an outside force?

No, nothing like that at all. My mind is completely clear, and I don't hear any strange voices or feel controlled. My only concern is what my husband is hiding from me and why everyone is helping him cover it up.
Do you have any history of medical conditions, such as head injuries, seizures, or thyroid problems, or are you currently taking any prescribed medications?
No, I don't have any history of things like head injuries, seizures, or thyroid problems. I'm also not taking any prescribed medications right now. Physically, my health has always been quite good.
Have you noticed any changes in your memory, your ability to concentrate, or your overall energy levels since these suspicions began?

No, my memory, concentration, and energy levels are completely fine. I still manage all my housework, attend choir practice, and run my home-organization consulting jobs without any trouble. The only real stress or distraction I have is dealing with what my husband is hiding from me.
How long have you held these specific suspicions about your husband, and have they caused any significant difficulties in your daily work or social life?

I’ve been completely sure about this for a little over a year now, since about last spring. My housework and home-organization jobs are going just fine, but I've stopped going to certain choir and walking groups to avoid them, and the constant fights at home have made my kids visit us less.

Aside from avoiding specific social groups and the strain on your family interactions, have these suspicions led you to engage in any unusual behaviors, such as monitoring your husband's phone, tracking his movements, or confronting others about your concerns?

I haven't done anything extreme like tracking his location, but I simply can't ignore obvious signs like him changing his phone password and whispering with that younger woman from church. I have questioned some of the ladies in my quilting and walking groups because I can tell they are helping him cover it up. I am not acting crazy; I just refuse to ignore what is right in front of my face.
Other than these specific suspicions regarding your husband, have you ever felt that your personality or your ability to handle your daily responsibilities has fundamentally changed in any other way?

No, my personality and my ability to handle my daily responsibilities haven't changed at all. I still keep up with my housework, choir practice, and my home-organization jobs just fine. People at church even say I seem like my usual self unless the topic of my husband and that woman comes up.
